topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Well, it seems like the winds of change are blowing through our little corner of the world. I've just heard about the building going condo, and I imagine this news might feel like quite a wave. I want you to know, it’s totally okay to take a moment, to breathe, and to process this. Changes like these can bring a mix of emotions. Maybe we can sit down together, go over what this means, and look at the options and possibilities ahead. I’m here to help sort through the details, and to make sure you feel as comfortable and informed as possible every step of the way. Let’s face this together, just like we've faced everything else.
